Setting: Phishing-Resistant Registration Bootstrap Available (Self-Service FIDO2 or TAP)
Recommendation: Give users with no phishing-resistant method a way to get one: either allow self-service FIDO2/passkey registration, or enable Temporary Access Pass so they can register FIDO2/a passkey without needing an existing strong method or their password. Without either, phishing-resistant rollout has no on-ramp. Timing note worth planning around: per Message Center MC1450133, from roughly mid-October to mid-November 2026 a user can register a passkey or FIDO2 key as their FIRST multifactor method rather than having to set up a weaker one first, with Windows Hello for Business, macOS Platform SSO and Authenticator passwordless following in a second phase around January-February 2027. That narrows this gap but does not close it, and the distinction matters: it helps someone who already HAS a password and needs to add MFA, while a genuinely new user holding no credential at all still needs a Temporary Access Pass (or admin provisioning) to get far enough in to register anything. Note also that Phase 2 lands after the 2027-02-01 SMS/Voice retirement, so don't plan phone-based migration around it.
